# ui-workspace

The workspace chat: one timeline over threads, with a compose box.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-workspace.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-workspace.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md), [ui-chat](ui-chat.md), [ui-compose](ui-compose.md)
- **Brings along:** [workspace](workspace.md) (the rest of it), [acp](acp.md) (its file requires it)

## About

The Emacs front end of workspace mode.  It is one buffer: a header,
a thread list, the timeline of messages and dividers, and the same
compose box a chat uses.  It talks to the harness only through ACP:
`_harness/workspace/get`, `_harness/workspace/timeline`,
`_harness/workspace/prompt`, and the `workspace/*` events.

The timeline is the workspace's, not a session's.  Each entry knows
the episode it belongs to, so `Open episode` opens the ordinary
session behind the thread when the user wants the full transcript.

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-ui-workspace-clear` — Clear the compose box.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer` — Show the computer of WORKSPACE, or of the current workspace.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-open-vnc` — Open the workspace computer's noVNC page.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-refresh` — Read the computer of the buffer's workspace again.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-restart` — Restart the workspace computer.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-return-control` — Return control of the workspace computer to the agent.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-screenshot` — Take a screenshot of the workspace computer and draw it here.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-start` — Start the workspace computer.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-stop` — Stop the workspace computer.
- `harness-ui-workspace-computer-take-over` — Give the reviewer control of the workspace computer.
- `harness-ui-workspace-new-thread` — Create a new thread and compose into it.
- `harness-ui-workspace-open-board` — Open the task board of this workspace.
- `harness-ui-workspace-open-episode` — Open the ordinary session behind the selected thread.
- `harness-ui-workspace-refresh` — Read the workspace again.
- `harness-ui-workspace-resources` — Show the resources of WORKSPACE, or of the current workspace.
- `harness-ui-workspace-resources-refresh` — Read the resources of the buffer's workspace again.
- `harness-ui-workspace-send` — Send the compose box's text to the workspace.
- `harness-ui-workspace-stop` — Stop the live turn of the selected thread.
- `harness-workspace` — Open the persistent workspace chat at POSITION.
